candidates.summary: og:image is built with path.Join("/", AssetsPath, card.image), which collapses an absolute AssetsPath such as https://cdn.example/ into /https:/cdn.example/..., so the card URL breaks wherever assets are served from another origin
candidates.failure_scenario: gnoweb run with -canonical-origin https://gno.land and an assets path pointing at a CDN origin: og:image and twitter:image read https://gno.land/https:/cdn.example/imgs/og-community-realm.png, a 404, so every link preview shows no card
candidates.verify_by: grep -n 'AssetsPath\|assets-path' gno.land/cmd/gnoweb/main.go gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/app.go to confirm an operator can set an absolute assets path; then a handler test with Static.AssetsPath="https://cdn.example/" and CanonicalOrigin set, asserting the og:image href
